ops.title: Verify and land query_graph observers (Lane C producer): first compile and test run is still owed
ops.description:
The observer change (note `a881eec`) sits uncommitted in the worktree `/Users/yasyf/.orca/workspaces/cc-transcript-accounting/durable-predicate-batch-20261012` on branch `yasyf/durable-predicate-batch-20261012`, base `origin/main@4f64810`. It was written and reviewed by reading only: the host job slot was never granted to this lane on 2026-10-12, so nothing has been compiled or run. The only checks were `rustfmt --check` on `snapshot.rs` and its test modules, a parse of `snapshot_prepared_service.rs`, and the schema generator's `--check`.

Edits were left uncommitted on purpose for the caller's reconciliation. Lane D (prepared-fact disk reuse) edits `rust/crates/core/src/snapshot.rs` in other regions; this change has three small hunks there.

What is owed before it can land:

- First compile of the core crate with and without default features. `snapshot_prepared_service.rs` is `include!`d, so `cargo fmt` does not cover it.
- First run of the new regressions in `rust/crates/core/src/snapshot_regressions.rs` and the contract tests in `tests/test_snapshot_contract.py`. Several regressions rest on fixture assumptions that were traced by reading, not run (see the lane reports under `/tmp/ram-pressure-refresh-20261012-1735/predicate-batch-*-report.json`; those files are host-local and may be gone).
- A release, because Captain Hook cannot turn observers on before its exact pin moves to a wheel that embeds the new request schema.

Open decisions for the owner, both recorded in note `a881eec`: whether to close the two bounded memory deviations, and whether to make glob matching total so `has_read_glob` and `has_edit_to` can become observers.

ops.text: cargo build and cargo test -p cc-transcript-core pass with --no-default-features and with default features, including every observer regression in snapshot_regressions.rs
cargo fmt --check passes and scripts/snapshot_contract.py cc_transcript/snapshot_schema --check reports no stale schema
The existing ledger and query_graph suites pass unchanged with the 56-byte larger PreparedQueryCursor
A cc-transcript release carrying the observers contract is tagged, and its version is recorded on the Captain Hook consumer task
